deep learning architectures are achieving the best performance in predicting DNA/RNA-binding specificities.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the architecture that uses kmer embedding, convolutional layer, recurrent layer, and fully connected layer outperforms all the other models in terms of model performance.
the architecture that uses kmer embedding, a convolutional and a recurrent layer outperforms all existing methods.
a hybrid CNN-RNN architecture that uses k-mers as sequence representation is the best architecture for DNA and RNA binding site prediction.
